Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

study — to learn about a subject. Example: I study every evening.
read — to look at words and understand them. Example: I read for thirty minutes.
write — to make words with a pen. Example: I write notes in class.
homework — school work you do at home. Example: I do my homework after dinner.
exam — a test of what you have learnt. Example: I have got an exam on Monday.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I study every evening.
• I do my homework.
• I have got an exam on ...
• I read and write notes.
• Good luck!
